english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for speaking or responding in an emotionally cold, unfriendly manner.

examples.english: They treated me frostily all evening, leaving me unsure what to say.
examples.traditional: 佢成晚都冷冰冰咁對住我，搞到我唔知講乜好。
